title: HSR filing deadlines
question: HSR filing deadlines (business days) across the corpus
notes: WP-1 query #18. Two registry gaps compounded here: (1) 'hsrFilingDeadlineBusinessDays' is merged into the legacy 'hsrFilingDeadline' (ISO-date-ish object) canonical entry, and when a provision carried BOTH raw keys, alias resolution always picked whichever was listed first rather than the literally-requested one — fixed in lib/query/resolve.js resolveFeatureValue (try the requested alias first). (2) the merged entry's declared type ('date') doesn't fit the business-day-count shape at all, and its deadline-object raw shape ({days, text, unit}) has no top-level 'value', which was leaking the raw object itself into results ([object Object] in the histogram) for deals whose HSR covenant only has effort-standard prose ("as promptly as practicable") and no fixed day count. Fixed with a query-layer type override (lib/query/types.js FIELD_TYPE_OVERRIDES, scoped to this one field alias) plus a defensive rule in valueFromRaw: never return a bare object as a query cell value. n=19 matches the spec's own coverage estimate exactly and is the correct count of deals with an actual extracted business-day figure (an earlier intermediate fix left n at 25 by letting prose-only deals leak in as text "data points" — corrected).
